paper_innovations.name: Dynamic Pattern + Online Precise Search
paper_innovations.description: First method to combine dynamic sparse patterns with precise online search for DiTs
paper_innovations.novelty: Addresses the unique hierarchical sparsity in DiTs that static and approximate methods fail to capture

technical_details.approach: Real-time computation of optimal sparse indices using block-wise attention
technical_details.complexity: O((1-sparsity)L²d) vs O(L²d) for full attention

paper_innovations.name: Blockified Pattern for Hierarchical Sparsity
paper_innovations.description: Introduces block-wise sparse patterns to capture DiTs' hierarchical structure
paper_innovations.novelty: Recognizes that continuous patterns fail due to modality boundaries and frame structure

technical_details.runtime_representation: Get_Time(L/B, L/B, B²) for block-wise computation

paper_innovations.name: Fused LSE-Cached Online Search
paper_innovations.description: Two-phase search leveraging LSE invariance across denoising steps
paper_innovations.novelty: Exploits observation that LSE distribution remains stable across diffusion steps

technical_details.phase1: Fused search: compute attention + cache LSE
technical_details.phase2: LSE-cached search: use cached LSE for subsequent steps
technical_details.runtime_representation: Get_Time(L, L, d) for phase1, Get_Time(0.2L, 0.2L, d) for phase2

paper_innovations.name: Head-adaptive Hierarchical Block Sparse Attention
paper_innovations.description: Adaptive sparsity adjustment per attention head based on recall performance
paper_innovations.novelty: Recognizes that different heads require different sparsity levels for optimal performance

technical_details.runtime_representation: Get_Time(0.15L, 0.15L, d) for high-recall heads, Get_Time(0.25L, 0.25L, d) for low-recall heads

proposed_improvements.name: Dynamic Block Size Selection
proposed_improvements.description: Adaptive block size based on content characteristics and attention entropy

implementation.method: Analyze attention entropy to determine optimal granularity
implementation.strategy: Small blocks (32) for high-detail, large blocks (128) for uniform areas

proposed_improvements.name: Content-Adaptive Search Strategy
proposed_improvements.description: Dynamic search step selection based on video complexity and motion analysis

implementation.method: Use motion vectors/optical flow for complexity assessment
implementation.strategy: Increase search frequency in high-motion regions

expected_benefits.runtime_representation: Variable Get_Time calls based on content complexity

proposed_improvements.name: Compressed LSE Cache
proposed_improvements.description: Lossy compression for cached LSE values to reduce memory overhead

expected_benefits.runtime_representation: Same Get_Time calls but with compressed data transfer

proposed_improvements.name: Learned Sparse Pattern Predictor
proposed_improvements.description: Lightweight meta-network to predict optimal sparse patterns without search

implementation.architecture: Small transformer taking video features as input
implementation.inference: Direct pattern prediction, no search needed

expected_benefits.runtime_representation: Get_Time(0.2L, 0.2L, d) with zero search overhead

proposed_improvements.name: Distributed AdaSpa
proposed_improvements.description: Multi-GPU scaling for handling ultra-long videos
